title: GARLIC JELLY | INDICA
description: Garlic Jelly is an indica strain, made from Jelly Breath and GMO genetics for a uniquely flavorful and heady experience. With a sweet, fruity jelly flavor underscored by savory garlic and herbal notes, it delivers a remarkable taste profile.
